title: pvMeshQuality
body:
## pvMeshQuality

Adds a cell array Quality rating the shape of each cell with a Verdict metric chosen per cell type (triangle, quad, tetrahedron, pyramid, wedge, hexahedron); other cell types get 0. Use it to locate distorted or degenerate cells before a simulation or to explain solver problems. Each metric has its own scale and ideal value (for example Scaled Jacobian is 1 for an ideal element and negative for inverted ones), so read thresholds from the Verdict documentation. ParaView's defaults are Radius Ratio (triangles, tetrahedra), Edge Ratio (quads, wedges), Shape (pyramids) and Maximum Aspect Frobenius (hexahedra). Use pvCellSize or cellSize for cell size.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- On a mixed mesh the single Quality array holds different metrics for different cell types; compare values only within one cell type or choose comparable metrics.
- Higher-order cells are measured by their own definition unless LinearApproximation is enabled, which adds Quality (Linear Approx).
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `MeshQuality`. Identity: `filters/MeshQuality`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |

ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Mesh Quality filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
